scope: Independent source review of explicit Zotero ODT export and minimal endnote import correction. No writer source edits by reviewer.

resolved_findings.finding: Span-three citation table exports could not reopen: ordinary relative-width style and repeated covered cells were outside the bounded native input contract.
resolved_findings.resolution: Writer owner added explicit-path absolute grid width, bounded explicit covered positions, and empty native continuation suppression; reviewer reproduction now reopens with one active field.

resolved_findings.finding: Opaque metadata guard called recursive XmlElement.text before enforcing descendant depth limits.
resolved_findings.resolution: Writer owner replaced DOM/subtree traversal with bounded streaming XmlPullReader scan, decoded text aggregation once and attribute checks.

resolved_findings.finding: Imported decimal ODT endnotes reverted to Word lowerRoman defaults after DOCX. Found by lifecycle owner.
resolved_findings.resolution: Reviewed minimal newly constructed section endnotePr/numFmt decimal override; preserves existing modeled geometry; lifecycle owner executes tests.

confirmed_contracts: Canonical Zotero_ prefix, logical ITEM CSL_CITATION/BIBL codes, terminal RND plus ten alphanumeric suffix characters match pinned plugin sources.
ReferenceMark field enumeration includes TextSections, as required for native bibliographies.
Sequential ZOTERO_PREF_N properties are concatenated by native plugin; <=255 UTF-16-unit chunks can safely avoid splitting supplementary characters.
Ownership maps, exact packet endpoint emission checks, field validity and native bibliography replacement guards refuse incomplete, overlapping, unowned and unsupported active field data.
Numbered/heading bibliography entry paragraphs refuse before output, preventing bibliography sections from illegal list-item nesting.
Note and table ownership are distinct and note IDs are qualified by footnote/endnote kind.
Read conversion remains strict for ordinary callbacks; toOdt only changes Field/Http output storage to ReferenceMark.
qualification_limits: General native ODT import still has layout/format/resource limits independent of editable Zotero export; no universal export/reimport claim.
Actual installed Zotero sessions and LibreOffice document behavior are outside this source review. Parent owns converter acceptance.
No additional broad test suites were run during this review; only concrete span-three regression reproduction was executed.
